caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular pouch or bag with rounded corners, placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The bag is primarily light brown or tan in color and features decorative stitched or embroidered patterns in darker brown and maroon shades, with leafy or floral motifs on its front surface. The upper edge of the bag has a band with geometric triangular designs in shades of brown and maroon, and there is a thin string or strap attached to the left side, rendered in a bluish hue. The bag's opening is outlined in a pale color and shows some embellishments or markings inside, which appear to be in pale maroon or pink. No other objects or elements appear in the image; the composition is straightforward, with the bag in the center and ample empty space around it.
title: Basket
